description: Source registry for automated monitoring of agricultural selling prices, seed prices, livestock prices, input costs, labour costs, FX and government statistics. Sources are monitored automatically where machine-readable access exists; uncertain changes are sent for review rather than silently published.

sources.notes: The updater discovers the latest NBS Food Price Watch ZIP and prepares candidate reference-price updates. Unit, geography and national-average column must be verified before publication.

Seed prices remain separate from crop selling prices because variety, brand, pack size, supplier and location can change independently. Add trusted machine-readable market, government, seed-regulator or agricultural-agency feeds as they become available.
FX is kept separate so currency conversion can be refreshed without changing agronomic assumptions.
